title: Stdlib - Vector - 3 [More Operations]
description:
## More Vector Operations
You know `push_back` and `pop_back`. Here are the rest:

- `vec.insert(vec.begin() + i, val)` - insert at position i
- `vec.erase(vec.begin() + i)` - remove at position i
- `vec.empty()` - returns true if vector has no elements
- `vec.front()` - first element
- `vec.back()` - last element
- `vec.clear()` - remove everything

```cpp
std::vector<int> nums = {10, 20, 30};
nums.insert(nums.begin() + 1, 15);  // {10, 15, 20, 30}
nums.erase(nums.begin());            // {15, 20, 30}
std::cout << nums.front();           // 15
std::cout << nums.back();            // 30
```
